$comment: merge-missing-keys, not merge or overwrite: it adds only missing keys
and never replaces a value already chosen by the developer.
semgrep.scan.configuration must stay fixed. The default falls back to
--config auto. The current p/default value still depends on registry/cache;
offline local rules are tracked in docs/roadmap.md.

a signed-in user, so it is handled through GPO (see vscode-gpo/).
